gradeBasis: Course levels depend on the demonstrated robot, measured targets and, above Pass where applicable, the contribution and bypass evidence. These project thresholds do not map automatically to a grade.
measurementBoundary: No three-trial acceptance score is available for this source revision. Historical E4/E12 observations below are context only. A finite host test or a terminal J3 reading is not a completed docking trial.
predictionBoundary: Predictions are prospective design expectations for this specification, not retrospective predictions of the historical measurements. Provisional budgets and ideal calculations are labelled; missing models stay PENDING.

courseSources.meaning: 3-5 measurable targets; at least one timing and one accuracy/repeatability target; ranges, tests, threshold and goal; three trials scored without choosing the best. Numerical examples are not mandatory specifications.
Name the claimed level and the modules supporting it. Marks and level depend on actual demonstration; goal/threshold performance is not a self-awarded grade.
Bring and submit the one-page formal datasheet. The separate product operating guide is supplementary.

targets.quantityUnit: Correct blue-marker identities (%) = correct / 60 expected labels per trial.
targets.conditions: Six official blue 1-6 signs, fixed and fully visible with >=10 px margin; camera 0.40-0.70 m away. Stable indoor light, no glare. VISION_ONLY; SW8=0, SW9=0; calibrated profile held fixed.
targets.threeTrialRule: Three tutor-chosen static poses. Per pose, score the first 10 distinct reports against a photographed label/region map: 6 labels x 10. Count bad/missing/ambiguous labels as wrong; no best-frame filtering. Use the LOWEST of three rates; require zero wrong accepted IDs.
targets.threshold: >=95%; zero wrong accepted IDs; every bay appears in each trial.
targets.predictedValue: 100% intended on the declared static sheet. Design expectation, not a proven physical success rate.
targets.measuredValue: E14: PENDING. E4 history: all six IDs present in 12/12 snapshots in each of three sets; this is not spatially truth-scored T1 accuracy.
targets.thresholdSource: Project-defined threshold/goal retained from tools/render_member_b_datasheet.py; not a course grade cut-off.

historicalEvidence.scope: Set presence only. No per-label spatial truth score or unobserved-frame claim. Physical distance was reported as 42 cm. This is not E14 evidence.

targets.quantityUnit: Sampled capture-to-result latency (ms): unsigned completionUs - captureStartUs.
targets.conditions: Same scene ranges as T1, nominal 25 fps and 320 x 240 RGB565. Use complete FPGA reports, including failed results; keep build/config fixed. No newly dropped/overflow frames during a scored trial.
targets.threeTrialRule: Use T1's three sets of 10 distinct reports. Take each set's maximum board-time latency, then the LARGEST of those three. A missing report or new drop/overflow fails the trial. This sampled maximum does not bound unsampled frames or camera-to-wheel latency.
targets.threshold: <=150 ms, with all three sets complete and no new drop/overflow.
targets.predictedValue: Provisional 100 ms budget: 40 ms capture  + 60 ms processing/commit allowance. Not a proven worst-case bound.
targets.measuredValue: E14: PENDING. E12 history: 38.818-57.066 ms across 90 sampled reports in one moving-target task; not the required three static sets.
targets.thresholdSource: Project-defined150/100ms retained from tools/render_member_b_datasheet.py. Course p4 camera-to-wheel example is a different quantity and is not used as this threshold.
targets.contribution: On-FPGA capture, candidate/reader processing and atomic report completion in perceptionCore.

historicalEvidence.scope: Sparse BCTL reports from one dynamic task, independently frozen from CCTL. No physical response or complete-frame-population latency claim.

targets.quantityUnit: Confirmed calibration attempt to new profile commit (ms); conservative observed upper bound.
targets.conditions: Red1 plus its paired blue reference, both complete and still; 0.40-0.70 m camera distance, stable indoor light, nominal 25 fps. VISION_ONLY; same build; independent rearm before each attempt.
targets.threeTrialRule: Three independently rearmed attempts. Log board-time trace from confirmed attempt through eight qualified samples and new-config commit. Use the LONGEST conservative interval. Failure, missing start/commit or >2 s is not a success; ACK alone does not count.
targets.threshold: All 3 commits <=2000 ms, each with 8 valid sample frames.
targets.predictedValue: Ideal 360 ms: (8 sample frames + 1 commit boundary) x 40 ms. Excludes pre-confirmation detection and rejected frames.
targets.measuredValue: E14: PENDING. E12 preflight showed calibrated=true and 8 sample frames; three independently timed attempts are absent.
targets.thresholdSource: Project-defined2s/1s retained from tools/render_member_b_datasheet.py. Ideal estimate follows the eight-frame sampling/commit design, not measured convergence.
targets.contribution: calibrationGeometry, calibrationPointMapper and real-pixel threshold/profile commit logic.

historicalEvidence.scope: Completed-state observation only; it does not identify three attempt start times or convergence intervals.

targets.quantityUnit: Absolute final gap error (mm): |ruler gap -350|, measured from J3 probe front to target plane.
targets.conditions: Already-visible blue 1-4, locked within U90-150; start gap 0.60-0.70 m. Flat plastic floor, vertical board spanning camera/J3 heights, unchanged supply/load. Fixed declared runtime settings for all 3 runs.
targets.threeTrialRule: Reset to the same start marks for 3 approaches. Stop a trial after 25 s if no autonomous DOCKED. Measure each settled ruler gap; use the LARGEST absolute error. Any timeout/manual stop/no DOCKED fails; J3 alone cannot replace the ruler.
targets.threshold: 3/3 autonomous docks; worst absolute error <=50 mm.
targets.predictedValue: PENDING braking/ranging error model. A logical 350 mm stop threshold is not a physical gap prediction.
targets.measuredValue: E14: PENDING. Latest E12 outside-view task ended INCOMPLETE at 60.007 s, not DOCKED; no valid T4 error. Earlier partial runs cannot be joined.
targets.thresholdSource: New project choice:350mm matches the controller's desired stopping gap;50/20mm are explicit project acceptance/goal values. They are not prescribed course values or a grade claim.
targets.contribution: Real-camera target qualification, motion_fsm approach/stop decisions and J3 safety integration.

historicalEvidence.scope: Different outside-view task, terminated by host observation limit. Final J3 distance407mm is not a scored docking gap.
